name: mp-port-map
title: The host's router mapping line in the lobby: mapped while the lobby is listed, and kept
capture_policy: The routers are loopback fakes started beside the run (tools/net_port_map_fake.py), so no packet reaches a real router; every runner seeds NetworkPortMapEnable = 0 and only this scene's host turns the mapping on by its argv. The lobby line is read from the label the player sees.

checklist.what: The listed lobby's router line reads the public endpoint the router mapped, through NAT-PMP, while the listing waits for the lobby's identity.
events: assert_label LabelLobbyPortMap "Public endpoint: 203\.0\.113\.7:" text="Public endpoint: 203\.0\.113\.7:\d+ via natpmp" PASS
assert_label LabelLobbyPortMap "via natpmp" text="Public endpoint: 203\.0\.113\.7:\d+ via natpmp" PASS

checklist.what: Three seconds later the line still reads the mapped endpoint: the mapping is not released while the lobby is listed.
events: assert_label LabelLobbyPortMap "Public endpoint: 203\.0\.113\.7:" text="Public endpoint: 203\.0\.113\.7:\d+ via natpmp" PASS
